qualifier: p53 and Cdc25A phospho-regulation and turnover
name: p53 phospho-regulation and turnover in DNA damage checkpoint
rationale: Members cover DNA damage checkpoint signaling via p53 phosphorylation, degradation and target transcription plus Cdc25A/CDK inhibition and (de)phosphorylation, unlike confusables centred on G1/S, G2/M cell-cycle machinery or replication.

name: Platelet aggregation regulation and GPVI-mediated activation
rationale: All members concern platelet activation or aggregation; GPVI/LDL sensitization separates it from VWF/GPIb adhesion confusables and positive/negative aggregation regulation from ADP/thrombin receptor confusables.

core: PCNA-dependent DNA synthesis in repair and replication
qualifier: UV-lesion nucleotide excision repair and translesion synthesis
name: UV-lesion excision repair, translesion synthesis and replicative DNA synthesis
rationale: Members span GG/TC-NER, translesion polymerases and replicative polymerase switching/primer synthesis, distinguishing it from base-excision, telomere C-strand and mismatch-repair confusables.

qualifier: direct demethylation and APOBEC cytidine deamination
name: Direct base demethylation and APOBEC cytidine deamination
rationale: Members are direct reversal of alkylation/methylation (ALKBH, MGMT, TET) and APOBEC C-to-U editing with antiviral restriction, unlike somatic hypermutation, A-to-I editing or excision-repair confusables.

name: Replication stress checkpoint and break-induced replication
rationale: Members concern intra-S checkpoint signaling, DNA unwinding/polymerase activation and break-induced replication with recombination-intermediate resolution, unlike telomere-maintenance and general homologous-repair confusables.

qualifier: Golgi organization, COPI and endosome-Golgi-lysosome routes
name: Golgi organization and Golgi-centred vesicle trafficking
rationale: Members cover Golgi structure, COPI traffic, endosome-to-Golgi retrograde and Golgi-to-lysosome/secretory routes, whereas confusables concern endocytic recycling to the plasma membrane.

name: Glucokinase regulation and glycogen turnover control
rationale: Members concern glucokinase/GCKR regulation and regulation of glycogen synthesis and breakdown, distinct from insulin signaling, glycogen storage disease, G6PC and glucagon/PKA confusables.

name: Reproductive, social and exploratory locomotor behaviour
rationale: Members are mating, parental, aggressive, grooming and exploratory/psychomotor behaviours with reproductive physiology, unlike learning, drinking/ethanol, parturition or sensory-behaviour confusables.

qualifier: neural plate regionalization and spinal neuron fate
name: Neural plate and tube patterning, spinal neuron fate specification
rationale: Members cover neural plate/tube regionalization, floor plate and axial mesoderm signaling centres and spinal motor/interneuron fate, unlike somitogenesis, craniofacial organ or convergent-extension confusables.

name: Core circadian clock transcriptional feedback loop
rationale: Members describe BMAL1:CLOCK activation, CRY:PER repression and degradation and clock entrainment, unlike confusables on metabolic clock outputs or neuronal MECP2/NPAS4 transcription.

name: Amyloid-beta production, fibril formation and clearance
rationale: Members regulate APP processing, amyloid fibril and tangle formation and amyloid-beta clearance, whereas confusables concern glial activation and proliferation.

qualifier: activating FGFR, ERBB and PDGFRA variants
name: Activating FGFR, ERBB and PDGFRA cancer variant signaling
rationale: All members are constitutive signaling by cancer-associated RTK mutants, amplifications or fusions, chiefly FGFR, EGFR/ERBB2 and PDGFRA, without the drug-resistance and ALK/FLT3 fusion content of confusables.

name: CSF1 and interleukin signaling in osteoclast-driven bone resorption
rationale: Members combine M-CSF and interleukin signaling with osteoclast differentiation, fusion and bone resorption, unlike myeloid differentiation and DAP12/macrophage-fusion confusables.

name: Dopamine synthesis and presynaptic neurotransmitter release regulation
rationale: Members concern catecholamine/dopamine synthesis and presynaptic transmitter release, uptake and spontaneous transmission, distinct from synaptic vesicle/structure confusables and dopamine transport/receptor confusables.

name: ATP release, ectonucleotidase hydrolysis and purinergic receptor signaling
rationale: Members center on ATP export, NTPDase hydrolysis and P2Y/adenosine receptor signaling, unlike general GPCR-calcium, histamine/eicosanoid or KATP confusables.

name: p53-dependent transcriptional induction of apoptosis after DNA damage
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of pro-death genes and positive regulation of p53-mediated intrinsic apoptosis, unlike BH3-only, p53 cell-cycle arrest and negative-regulation confusables.

qualifier: radiation-induced checkpoint, apoptosis control and senescence
name: p53-mediated DNA damage checkpoint and apoptosis control after irradiation
rationale: Members cover radiation responses, DNA damage checkpoint, p53 phosphorylation, bidirectional regulation of p53-mediated apoptosis and senescence, unlike confusables centred on p53 target transcription.

name: PTK6 non-receptor tyrosine kinase signaling and regulation
rationale: Most members are PTK6 expression, activation by ERBB2 and downstream effects, with AKT activation and ERBB2:ERBB3 downregulation, distinct from ERBB/MET receptor signaling confusables.

name: Calcium release from intracellular stores and store-operated entry
rationale: Members regulate ER/SR calcium release (ryanodine, caffeine), store-operated entry and calcium sensing, whereas confusables concern calcium extrusion, Na/Ca exchange and cardiac contraction.

name: Glutamate-family and aspartate amino acid nitrogen metabolism
rationale: Members cover glutamate, glutamine, proline, arginine and aspartate metabolism with ammonium handling, unlike urea-cycle disorder and glyoxylate/2-oxoglutarate confusables.

name: Smooth muscle contraction-relaxation balance and endothelin-driven vasoconstriction
rationale: Members regulate smooth muscle contraction versus relaxation, vasoconstriction, endothelin and pulmonary pressure, unlike confusables centred on NO-cGMP-mediated vasorelaxation.

name: Glycolytic flux control by fructose bisphosphates and fermentation
rationale: Members regulate glycolysis via fructose 2,6- and 1,6-bisphosphate, lactate fermentation and pentose-phosphate shunt, unlike p53/mTORC1/HIF metabolic-regulation and hexokinase confusables.

name: Collagen and elastic fiber assembly and MMP-mediated degradation
rationale: Members cover collagen/elastin synthesis, crosslinking, fibril organization and MMP-driven degradation, whereas confusables lack the degradation side or are generic extracellular matrix modules.

name: Growth hormone receptor signaling and its regulation
rationale: All three members are growth hormone receptor (JAK-STAT) signaling or its regulation, distinct from leptin, IL-6, insulin and IL-2/STAT5 confusables.

qualifier: p53 pro-apoptotic targets and BH3-only proteins
name: p53 pro-apoptotic targets and BH3-only cytochrome c release
rationale: Members are p53 transcription of death genes and PUMA/NOXA BH3-only inactivation of BCL-2 driving cytochrome c release, unlike BAX/BAK-apoptosome confusables and GO p53-class regulation confusables.
